summary: Joshua Tuthill of Cutchogue (1690–1782), husband of Hannah Reeve and brother of James Tuthill, John's 8th-great-grand-uncle.
bio:
Joshua Tuthill was born in 1690 and lived at Cutchogue in Southold. He married Hannah, a daughter of Maj. James Reeve of Mattituck. Their children were James, born in 1727, Samuel, John of Speonk, born in 1728, Isaac, Deborah, who married Elijah Terry, Hannah, Deliverance and possibly Daniel. He died at Cutchogue on 2 June 1782.

He was a full brother of James Tuthill, John's 8th-great-grand-uncle, and the two brothers have sometimes been confused in family records, Joshua's marriage to Hannah Reeve having been attributed to James. The family's Wells and Tuthill descent, and its Society of Colonial Wars line through William Wells, stand either way.
